sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Zombie Incursion World is a first-person shooter game, with players controlling their character as they navigate the game's procedurally generated maps. The game's controls are easy to pick up, with the left mouse button used to fire and the arrow keys or WASD keys used for movement. Players can also crouch using the C key, jump using the space bar, and throw bombs using the G key. The game's shooting mechanics are simple yet satisfying, with a variety of guns and ammo types available to choose from.

One of the things that sets Zombie Incursion World apart from other first-person shooters is its focus on movement and positioning. Players need to use their surroundings to their advantage, luring zombies into traps and using the environment to take out groups of enemies at once. This adds a layer of strategy to the game, as players need to think carefully about their approach and use their skills and gear to their advantage.

Overall, the game's core gameplay mechanics are engaging and fun, with a variety of challenges and obstacles to overcome.
